name: brine-theme
description: Dark violet/indigo theme for the Pterodactyl Panel user area - #19152e page, #2b254c surfaces, #2b87d3 accent, fixed sidebar shell, redesigned dashboard, login, console and file manager. Admin area, favicon and page title untouched.

files.note: Emits every colour utility as rgb(var(--pt-*)) on Tailwind 3.1+ and as baked-in hex on 2.1/3.0, which cannot apply an opacity modifier to a CSS variable; adds navy/gold brand ramps and aliases blue/primary to navy and cyan to gold
Stock head (title, favicons, theme-color) + palette stylesheet link only
ptColor() helper for Chart.js - dark-only, no theme state
brandName()/logoUrl()/registrationEnabled()/backgroundImage()/backgroundStyle() - site name, uploaded icon, registration switch and the two background slots from window.SiteConfiguration

Violet/indigo tokens (#19152e page, #2b254c surface, #2b87d3 accent, system fonts), a fixed violet/cyan aurora field behind every screen, frosted glass on the sidebar/topbar/drawer/auth card and tinted glass on the cards, admin-set background image layers for the auth screens and the dashboard - shell/auth/dashboard/console/file-manager styles
Brand mark used by the sidebar and the login screen
Fixed sidebar + sticky topbar + mobile drawer shell for dashboard and server routes, applies the dashboard background image
Aternos-style sidebar with brand block, permission-filtered server/account navigation and user footer
Topbar: burger, title, search, nav links, avatar (theme toggle removed)
Wraps the dashboard in AppShell and drops the legacy SubNavigation
Wraps server routes in AppShell and drops the legacy SubNavigation
Auth routes: centres the login card, adds /auth/register, applies the auth background image
Login card: centred container, logo chip header, title/subtitle slot and the conditional Register link footer
Login form + success flash after registration (?registered=1)
Public registration form (email, first/last name, username, password, confirm) posting to /auth/register
CSRF + POST /auth/register client
Same treatment for the 2FA checkpoint screen
Same treatment for the password recovery screen
Same treatment for the password reset screen
Branded hero header, section title and empty state
Server cards with status/allocation chips, CPU/MEM/DISK stat blocks and colour bars
Adds the shared footer, showing the panel site name
Sharp 3px buttons with uppercase letter-spaced labels
Branded console header with status chip and gold call-to-action power button
Marks the Start button for the gold call-to-action treatment
Terminal chrome: window bar, dots, title and command hint
Navy-black terminal, neutral stat cards and gold accents
Console detail stat blocks re-skinned to neutral cards with gold icons
Resolves chart palette through ptColor()
Resolves chart grid/tick/line colours through ptColor()
Toolbar layout and branded empty state
Navy path bar with gold links and monospaced type
Card-style file rows with icon tiles, size and modified columns
File manager row, tile, empty-state and mass-action styles
Branded selection bar with selection counter
Admin -> Site Settings: site name, icon, the two background slots (auth/dashboard - upload or pasted link, each with an on/off switch) and each slot's overlay colour + intensity

Site Settings page: name + icon, then a per-area background block (Login & Register, Dashboard) each with a switch, a link-or-upload field, and an overlay intensity/colour adjuster with a live preview
POST /auth/register - creates the account directly with the panel's own UserCreationService (hashed password, welcome e-mail, no API key)
Admin -> Registration: enable/disable public sign-up
Registration settings page with the enable switch
Exposes SiteConfiguration.logo / .registration.enabled / .backgrounds; reports recaptcha as disabled so the widget never renders and the exhausted-quota lockout cannot happen
Stock auth routes + GET/POST /auth/register, throttled; drops the stock recaptcha middleware, which would reject every login with HTTP 400 once the shared public keys exhaust their quota
Stock routes + /admin/site-settings + /admin/registration; /admin/branding now redirects to Site Settings
Stock admin layout + Site Settings and Registration menu items, favicon from the uploaded icon
